pharmacology.text: GBL is not active in its own right; its mechanism of action stems from its identity as a prodrug of GHB.

uses.text: Gamma-Butyrolactone is used as a chemical solvent and a cleaning agent, for example in paint stripping or for cleaning graffiti. Butyrolactone is a precursor to other chemicals. Reaction with methylamine gives NMP, and with ammonia gives pyrrolidone. It is also used as a solvent in lotions and some polymers.

summaryZh: γ-丁內酯是一種易潮解的無色油狀液體，有較弱的特徵氣味並且能溶於水。γ-丁內酯是化學中的一個常見溶劑和反應試劑，它也被用作一種芳香物、去污劑、氰基丙烯酸酯去除劑、除漆劑以及一些液體鋁電解電容器的溶劑。

sideEffects.en: It causes the same effects as GHB: drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, confusion and, at higher amounts, loss of consciousness and slowed breathing. The gap between an active amount and an overdose is small, and the liquid can burn the mouth and throat. Regular use can cause dependence with a dangerous withdrawal that may include seizures and delirium.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用與 GHB 相同：嗜睡、頭暈、噁心、嘔吐、意識混亂，量較大時會失去意識並抑制呼吸。有效量與過量之間的差距很小，原液還可能灼傷口腔和喉嚨。長期使用可能造成依賴，戒斷可能很危險，包括癲癇發作和譫妄。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用与 GHB 相同：嗜睡、头晕、恶心、呕吐、意识混乱，量较大时会失去意识并抑制呼吸。有效量与过量之间的差距很小，原液还可能灼伤口腔和喉咙。长期使用可能造成依赖，戒断可能很危险，包括癫痫发作和谵妄。

fact.en: GBL does nothing much by itself. Enzymes in the blood called lactonases quickly open its ring and turn it into GHB, which is why it acts faster than GHB itself.
fact.zh: GBL 本身幾乎沒有作用。血液中的內酯酶會迅速打開它的環狀結構，把它變成 GHB，這也是它比 GHB 起效更快的原因。
fact.zhHans: GBL 本身几乎没有作用。血液中的内酯酶会迅速打开它的环状结构，把它变成 GHB，这也是它比 GHB 起效更快的原因。
